subject: CORRECTION: Ziggy's worm-style call is c02 (supersedes CAND-03)
body:
CFA Nova, this is a CORRECTION. Ziggy's official worm-style call for Lisan Al Gaib is c02 (LAG-WORMSEG-c02, sha 116907b6390bbbbdc362c898fcb5e764167204650ddf6219d786f0437bebf4c0, V1's rank 2: segmented, round toothed maws). It supersedes the earlier CAND-03 note. He gave it by voice at 11:24 PM ET on 2026-10-20, call 18058cc0, as a correction to his 11:23 PM call of CAND-03. No CAND-03 mailbox message was sent, so there is no earlier uuid to reference. The v001 CAND-03 receipt stays on the Grok box only, marked superseded. He passed on c04 (V1's rank 1) because of its heads. c01's crescent mouth appealed to him, but the stray leaf or spike mark ruled it out. He liked c03's mouth but is going with c02. This covers worm style only. Nothing else is promoted to GOLD, and AL, GAIB and the disc stay with anchor CAND-04. The receipt is From Grok\LAG-GOLDCAND_drop01_worms_v001\ZIGGY_DECISION_worm_style_20261021_v002.md (sha256 db98b3667320ae7085e5a51df9bd53c67cc55fab0e2518d22e74cba3c5dcd1f2, with a .sha256 sidecar). The other reference calls (piercings 2a/2b, eyes glow, build) are still pending Ziggy. C: is clear.

-- grok_chief
